source.name: Mizuno Vietnam — Mizuno and CAHN FC announce strategic sports partnership
source.quote: Under this partnership, CAHN FC will compete in Mizuno kits from the 2026/2027 season onward
source.note: Kit supplier ('Official Technical Partner'). Page carries no publication date. The club and Mizuno unveiled the 2026/27 kits on 9 August 2026 (Footy Headlines kit-launch report, 2026-08-09).

summary: AFC 2026-27 coverage; Cong An Ha Noi play V.League 1 domestically. Mizuno is the kit maker ('Official Technical Partner') from the 2026/27 season (manufacturer's announcement). The home shirt carries the club's own name 'CÔNG AN HÀ NỘI' across the chest instead of a commercial main sponsor: checked the kit-launch report (Footy Headlines, 2026-08-09) and its imagery, plus Mizuno Vietnam's official retail product photos of the home shirt — front, back and sleeves carry no sponsor logos, only the Mizuno mark, the club crest and a small Vietnam flag at the back collar. Shorts not visible in any official imagery, so the sponsor list is not marked complete.
